en.headline: Hong Kong Wine and Dine Festival returns to harbourfront from 29 October
en.dek: The four-day event organised by the Tourism Board will feature more than 340 booths at Central Harbourfront and Tamar Park, with later hours on Friday and Saturday.
body: The Hong Kong Tourism Board is bringing back the Hong Kong Wine and Dine Festival from 29 October to 1 November at the Central Harbourfront Event Space and Tamar Park.

This year's edition will have more than 340 booths, an increase of over 10 per cent from last year, drawing flavours from about 31 countries and regions. Opening hours will run until 1am on Friday and Saturday for the first time. The board expects around 168,000 visitors.

The festival is followed by Hong Kong Gourmet Month throughout November, during which ticket holders can present admission stubs at participating outlets for offers. Admission for adults starts at HK$40, with concessions available, and tasting tokens are sold separately.

zh.headline: 香港美酒佳餚巡禮10月29日起重返中環海濱
zh.dek: 旅發局主辦的四日盛事設逾340個攤位於中環海濱活動空間及添馬公園舉行，周五六延長至凌晨1時。
body: 香港旅遊發展局將於10月29日至11月1日在中環海濱活動空間及添馬公園重辦香港美酒佳餚巡禮。
今屆設超過340個攤位，較去年增加逾10%，匯聚約31個國家及地區的美酒美食。周五及周六開放時間首次延長至凌晨1時。旅發局預計吸引約16.8萬人次。
巡禮之後將於11月舉行香港美食月，入場人士可憑票根於參與商戶換取優惠。成人入場費由40元起，設優惠價，品味券另售。
